resources.string: Worldwide forecasts, city search and map providers are implemented but await provider terms, privacy and usage approval. Saved coordinates and US NWS forecasts remain available.
NWS forecasts are preferred in US coverage; Open-Meteo supplies worldwide forecasts. Weather is model data, not a guaranteed observation. Missing values stay unavailable.
Searching sends the city you enter and your IP address to Open-Meteo. Choose a result to save its coordinates locally. No device location is collected.

Weather requests disclose selected coordinates and your IP address to the provider. Approved city search sends only your submitted query. Approved maps request only the visible area. No provider request contains stream URLs. Services may retain request logs under their own policies.
Use the direction buttons to move the map, zoom controls to change scale, and markers or the saved-source list to select a source. Polar areas beyond map coverage remain blank.
No places match this name. Check the spelling or add the country.

Find location sends only the city or name you search for to Open-Meteo. Cameras that name a city but lack its country, coordinates or time zone are completed the same way in the background; stream links are never sent.
